summary: Iteration 6 (Midtrans demo-mode gating, email logs, lazy expiry, payment gating, admin integrations, SEO). Backend: new test_phase4_payments_email.py (11 tests) + in-process test_payments_webhook_unit.py (9 tests, fake Midtrans keys set only inside the pytest process) all pass; full regression suite 44 passed / 5 obsolete skipped. Verified: /payments/config enabled:false, client_key '', is_production true; snap/check/notification return 503; new booking payment_status demo_deferred; demo flow accept->deliver->complete credits exactly 2 ledger entries; email_logs booking_new (naya.test@example.com) and booking_delivered (customer.test@example.com) with status disabled and detail 'EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY belum tersedia', responses fast; lazy expiry -> cancelled/expired with history by system; deliver on unpaid -> 400 'setelah pembayaran', on paid -> 200; customer/photographer cancel paid -> 400, admin cancel -> refund_pending; admin overview payments+email_enabled false; /admin/emails list, 403 for non-admin. Webhook unit: bad signature 401, missing fields 400, unknown order 404, amount mismatch 400 (booking unchanged), capture with fraud=challenge 400, pending->settlement->paid, duplicate notification 'duplicate' (one history entry), stale pending after settlement ignored, booking_paid email logged disabled, cancel after settlement -> reversed. Frontend (Playwright): /customer/pesanan payment labels, Bayar sekarang visible for accepted+unpaid with due time, click -> toast 'Pembayaran online belum diaktifkan'; photographer row hides Serahkan hasil and shows waiting text; /admin integrations notice; /admin/email table renders 20 rows; policy page mentions Midtrans, 24 jam, escrow. SEO: robots.txt & sitemap.xml 200 with jasakamerata.com URLs. canonical/og:url were MISSING from served HTML until I restarted the frontend (CRA dev server caches public/index.html); after restart present.

minor.issue: Settlement is applied to booking regardless of booking.status. If customer cancels an unpaid booking (allowed) or it lazily expires after Snap was opened, a late settlement makes booking status=cancelled + payment_status=paid with no refund_pending flag -> money received but order cancelled silently. Suggest: if booking.status != 'accepted' on success, set payment_status='refund_pending' (or paid_after_cancel) + history/audit for admin.
asyncio.create_task result not referenced; per Python docs tasks may be GC'd mid-flight. Keep a module-level set of tasks and discard on done.

Raises ValueError inside the background task before logging; user-provided text (location/customer name containing e.g. 'cvv' or a domain-like string) would cause silent drop with no email_logs entry. Catch and log status 'blocked'.
Bookings stuck in payment_status 'pending' (VA created, no final webhook received) are never expired; relies entirely on Midtrans expire webhook/check.

integration_issues.issue: canonical/og:url added to public/index.html were not served until frontend restart (dev server caching). Fixed by restart; production build will include them.
